statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low and well below the block threshold, while Stress is moderate on a record-high index coinciding with 19-year-high Treasury yields.
recommendation: Conditions are consistent with normal mean-reverting behaviour. A narrow caution window is published around the 13:30Z US cash open and the 13:45Z flash PMI, where two-sided repricing is most likely.
headline: NQ futures flat in a two-sided overnight range after a record NDX close; low Tail, moderate Stress into the flash PMI
body: Nasdaq-100 futures are near 31,037, essentially unchanged, inside a roughly 112-point two-sided overnight range that followed a record NDX cash close at 30,732 (session high 30,770, its first record since June). VIX near 14.2 is subdued and retracements are occurring, so the pathological no-retracement path that defines Tail risk is not present. The offsetting factor is cross-asset conflict rather than directional efficiency: the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.97% sits close to a 19-year high after the 16 September Fed hike to 3.75-4.00%, with a majority of policymakers signalling at least one further increase this year, and Brent near $99.7 remains up sharply year-on-year even after five losing sessions on US-Iran diplomatic progress and the restart of the Saudi East-West pipeline. Index leadership is narrow, with memory and semiconductor names driving gains while the Dow closed 0.36% lower and consumer-facing technology lagged; that internal rotation reduces directional conviction and supports range behaviour at the index level. Scheduled catalysts today are the S&P Global flash PMI at 13:45Z, a Fed Barr appearance near 14:05Z and a 5-year note auction at 17:00Z, which raise Stress and define a narrow caution window without yet constituting observed Tail structure.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail ran 10-21 with three WATCH hours around the 22 September US cash session and power hour, then decayed steadily through the Asian and European overnight to 10-11 as the post-record path stayed orderly. Stress eased from the mid-40s to the low 30s and dominant mode rotated from trend-up through mixed back to normal.
outlookSummary: The published path keeps Tail low for the European morning, lifts it to a WATCH band of 20-21 for the two hours containing the 13:30Z US cash open, the 13:45Z flash PMI and the Fed Barr appearance, then decays through the afternoon with a smaller bump around the 17:00Z 5-year note auction and the 19:00-20:00Z power hour. Overnight into 24 September returns to 11-13 with confidence declining as the live evidence base ages. Tail stays below the block threshold in every published hour.
